users.map: function(doc) { if(doc.type === 'user') { emit(doc._id, {total_points: doc.total_points, level: doc.level, listening_time: doc.listening_time}); } }

usernames.map: function(doc) { if(doc.type === 'username') { emit(doc._id, {username: doc.username, display_name: doc.display_name}); } }

servers.map: function(doc) { if(doc.type === 'server') { emit(doc._id, {name: doc.name, last_updated: doc.last_updated}); } }

voice_time.map: function(doc) { if(doc.type === 'voice_time') { var guild_id = doc._id.replace('voice_time:', ''); emit(guild_id, doc.data); } }

deployments.map: function(doc) { if(doc.type === 'deployment') { emit(doc._id, {version: doc.version, timestamp: doc.timestamp, status: doc.status}); } }
